title: Inference rule
summary: An inference rule licenses a transition from specified premises to a conclusion.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared formal proof system context is fixed.

content.plain: An inference rule licenses a transition from specified premises to a conclusion.
content.exact: A rule is a schema Γ/P whose instances permit P to be appended to a derivation whenever the required premises Γ are available under the declared side conditions.
content.example: Modus ponens licenses Q from P and P→Q after the formulas and variables are matched correctly.
content.caveat: A rule's soundness depends on a semantics; its syntactic admissibility does not prove that soundness.
